purpose: Teach: ジャングル/大谷/月日/レンタカー/横須賀/姓/細工/繁華

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、テレビで、ジャングル探検の番組、見たことある?私、最近、はまっちゃって、毎日、見てるのよ、本当に、面白いの、本当に。
lines.en: Aoi, have you ever seen that jungle exploration show on TV? I've gotten really into it lately—watch it every day. It's genuinely so good.
lines.style: Warm, animated opening. Breathy enthusiasm that reaches for connection. Light-speed pacing on the recommendations. Slight lean-in on "genuinely"—she wants Aoi to understand how much she loves this.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。野球の大谷選手、本当に、すごいよね、メイちゃん、世界中、活躍してて、葵で、お客様、よく、話題にしてるよ、本当に。
lines.en: Yeah, I know! Baseball player Ohtani is amazing, Mei. He's doing so well all over the world. People at the café talk about him all the time, honestly.
lines.style: Animated agreement that pivots mid-thought. Bright and natural, like she's following her own thread. Warm recognition when she says Mei's name. Gentle, conversational pace—remembering, not reciting.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵と、出会ってから、もう、随分、月日、経ったよね、本当に、長い間の、友達、ありがたいわよね、私、感謝してる、本当に、ずっと。
lines.en: It's been quite a while since we met, hasn't it? So much time has passed. I'm really grateful for a friendship this long. Thank you, truly, for all of it.
lines.style: Softer opening. Tender and sincere without performance. Slight catch on "grateful," like she's feeling it fresh. Trailing thoughtfulness at the end. The voice of someone taking a moment to really say something true.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 夏休み、家族で、レンタカー、借りて、ドライブ旅行、行く予定なの、葵で、メイちゃんも、機会あったら、一緒に、行きたいよね。
lines.en: We're planning a summer road trip with a rental car this year. I was thinking—Mei, if you get a chance, would you want to come along with us?
lines.style: Warm, bright invitation. Light, conversational tone that makes the offer feel natural, not heavy. Slight lift at the end of the question—genuinely hoping for a yes, not performing hope.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 横須賀、自衛隊の艦船、見学できるって、聞いたよ、葵、興味、あるかしらね、一緒に、行ってみる?本当に、面白そうだよ、絶対。
lines.en: I heard you can visit the JSDF ships in Yokosuka. I'm curious—does that interest you? Would you want to go check it out together? It sounds like it'd really be something.
lines.style: Curious and inviting, like she's discovered something cool and wants to share it. Gentle energy—not pushy, genuinely wondering. Slight brightening on "really be something," like the idea excites her.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 結婚すると、私、姓が、変わるのよね、ちょっと、寂しい気持ち、あるわよ、葵で、新しい姓に、慣れるまで、時間、かかりそうだね。
lines.en: When I get married, my last name will change. There's something a little bittersweet about that, honestly. It'll probably take some time to get used to the new name.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly distant. Quiet vulnerability—thinking aloud without heaviness. Gentle, measured pace. Touching on something tender without dwelling. The voice of someone processing something small but real.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お土産屋さんで、伝統工芸の、細工物、買ったよ、葵、見て、本当に、繊細な、作品、職人さんの技、すごいよね、本当に。
lines.en: I picked up some traditional craft pieces at a souvenir shop. Aoi, look at these—the work is so delicate. The artisans' skill is just incredible.
lines.style: Genuine admiration that wants to share. Warm but genuinely awed. Slight pause before naming Aoi—a natural moment of turning to show her. Light emphasis on "delicate" and "incredible"—not exaggerated, just sincere wonder.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 最近、繁華街、活気、戻ってきたよね、葵、お店、また、賑わってきたわよ、本当に、嬉しいわよ、これから、頑張りたいね、私、一緒に。
lines.en: The downtown area is really coming back to life lately, isn't it? The shops are busy again. It makes me so happy. I want to keep working hard going forward—with you, if possible.
lines.style: Bright and hopeful closing. Animated but grounded. Warmth on the recognition of bustle returning. Slight softening and drawing-in on "with you"—genuine, not sentimental. Forward-looking energy without strain.
